cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (single-arm; composite including stable disease)
cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “DCR IN PATIENTS TAKING KRAZATI: 80% (n=112; 95% CI: 70.8-86.5)” | “Depth of response: 80% of patients experienced tumor shrinkage of any magnitude.” | “Stable Disease: 37%”
cases.context: Waterfall plot; accelerated approval on ORR/DOR from single-arm KRYSTAL-1; Bad Ad complaints received.
cases.rationale: Stable disease in a single-arm trial cannot be attributed to the drug; DCR composite unsupported.
cases.check: Rule: flag 'disease control rate' or 'stable disease' claims sourced from single-arm studies.

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (single-arm time-to-event endpoints)
cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “MEDIAN OS IN PATIENTS TAKING KRAZATI: 14.1 MONTHS” | “MEDIAN PFS IN PATIENTS TAKING KRAZATI: 6.9 MONTHS”
cases.context: 'Descriptive analysis' label and disclaimer that single-arm trials don't characterize OS/PFS do not cure.
cases.rationale: Time-to-event endpoints in single-arm trials are uninterpretable.
cases.check: Rule: flag OS/PFS/median survival claims whose source is a single-arm trial, regardless of disclaimers.

cases.cat: Overstatement of efficacy (pooled data inconsistent with label)
cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “DESCRIPTIVE ANALYSIS MEDIAN DOR IN PATIENTS TAKING KRAZATI: 12.5 MONTHS.”
cases.context: PI median DOR 8.5 months (95% CI 6.2-13.8); claim based on pooled 'data on file'.
cases.rationale: Pooled data contradict and overstate labeled DOR.
cases.check: Rule: numeric efficacy values must match the PI value for the same endpoint; flag discrepancies and 'data on file' / pooled sources.

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (post hoc / exploratory)
cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “33% INTRACRANIAL ORR IN PATIENTS WITH STABLE, ADEQUATELY TREATED BRAIN METASTASES” | “INTRACRANIAL DCR IN PATIENTS WITH BRAIN METASTASES: 85% (n=33; 95% CI: 68-95).”
cases.context: Post hoc subgroup; 27 of 33 previously irradiated; caveat statements do not mitigate.
cases.rationale: Effects may reflect prior radiation; post hoc single-arm data cannot establish benefit.
cases.check: Are subgroup results confounded by prior/concomitant therapy presented as drug effects?
